_doc: Map 4 Act IV's endings (UPDATE 07, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md §11.5–§11.6, §12.11, T-113): the epilogue cards (period style, one per character present plus the fixed ones; the cities per the bomb run's flags bomb_<city>_hit / _saved / _dud; Peg's by peg_delivered), the stock-shot dioramas the cancel ending films (gravelight/world/endings/ending_diorama.gd builds each from its id), the titles and the saga credits. Writer rule LORE.md 2.4: no 'subscription', no company name; the Woman in Violet is never named.

dioramas.caption: The Crossroads Inn. A Gänger at the bar sits down on the bench, and is still. The fire pops.
Kaltenbrunn, the Salt Chapel. The bell stops. Snow through the roof.
Totenhafen. The tide comes in over nothing that moves.
Werk Thalbach. The works' PA clicks off. Wittkamp's office light is on.
London. The violet snow stops falling. Dawn. A siren winding down.

cards.london: The violet snow stopped at 05:12 on 12 May. The city counted its dead and did not count them twice.
cards.boston: The harbour burned for a night. In the morning the fire went out and stayed out.
cards.city_dud: A casing came down in %s and did not open. On its side, in chalk, three strokes and a hook. Nobody has washed it off.
cards.dutch: He went to Wilcza Góra in 1947 with a letter and a bad knee. There was a Pilch at the inn. They talked until the bar closed.
cards.peg_resigned: Her resignation was never accepted. Her report was never filed. She bought a bookshop in Bath and sold a great many maps.
cards.peg_delivered: She delivered. The program was closed in June by men who had read the manifest. She was not asked to the hearing.
cards.deacon: He went home to Ruthie and did not send the letter. He read it to her instead, once, and then they burned it together.
cards.wren: She found one hundred and forty of the two hundred names, alive, in a camp near Erfurt. The notebook has sixty-three marks and one more. She never explains the last one.
cards.jakub: He walked home. Marta's reply, dated June 1945, says only: "You are late for supper. Come in."
cards.dee: She held the range for eleven more days. The relief column found her in the cage with the radio on. She said: "About time. Nothing goes to waste; that includes you."
cards.hale: Mr. Hale retired to a house with a good view and no telephone. He has never explained what he was listening for.
cards.fasbender: He was allowed to keep the telescope. He points it at the Moon on clear nights, and says it is only to check.
cards.wittkamp: He unlocked his office on the fourteenth. The model aeroplane is in a museum. The caption does not say what it was for.
cards.moon: The smile is still there. The light is not.
cards.bolt: They went home by the usual route. Sprocket wrote a memo. Forty billion people read it this time.
cards.vendelin: Field Merchandiser Unit V-1 is listed as "extended leave." He runs a small repair shop in Basel. The sign says: TERMS ON THE BACK. PLEASE READ THEM.

credits: every one of them had a name
a woman in violet, who is not named here
Written, built and played in the Bolt & Sprocket workshop
Nachtglas is a lie. The light is not.
